[fact] The Telegram bot had a bug where session IDs were never cleared from the in-memory _sessions dict after idle timeouts or explicit session ends, causing session state to persist incorrectly across conversations.

[fact] Delivering .docx files via Telegram requires careful pre-flight checks: (1) File generation depends on python-docx — always verify its availability on the host before promising this delivery format. (2) On Windows, there is no native base64 CLI, so Python or PowerShell must be used for file encoding prior to multipart upload via the Telegram Bot API. Skipping either check
